description: This file defines the internal class PrefixingBufferWriter, which implements IBufferWriter<byte> and IDisposable. It manages a buffer with a reserved header prefix, used to insert length headers in message payloads within the Orleans messaging framework.

classes.name: PrefixingBufferWriter
classes.description: Implements a buffer writer that reserves space for a fixed-size header, efficiently handling message encoding with optional payload size hints.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the writer by the specified number of bytes, updating internal counters.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> region for writing, initializing internal buffers if necessary.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> for writing, falling back to GetMemory if needed, optimized for small writes.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Writes the prefix into reserved space and commits the payload to the underlying PipeWriter.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the internal PipeWriter to start writing.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Requests initial memory from the underlying PipeWriter and sets up buffer spans.
